title: No clear winner after tight New Zealand general election - BBC
description: Weeks of coalition talks could follow after preliminary results pointed to a highly divided national parliament.

title: Drone and missile attacks wound 9 as Ukraine prepares for talks with Russia and the US - AP News
description: Drone and missile explosions wounded at least nine people across Ukraine Saturday, as Kyiv and Moscow prepared for new talks next week with the United States. Negotiators from the three countries are set to meet Tuesday in Abu Dhabi to discuss ending the war.…

title: The ‘slam dunk’ that wasn’t: Promising cholesterol drug fails to prevent heart attacks or stroke - NBC News
description: An experimental drug that held great promise in driving down a dangerous form of cholesterol didn’t show any measurable impact on heart attack or stroke in a clinical trial.

title: Historic voter turnout powered Democrats’ blue wave - The Washington Post
description: Voter turnout reached its second-highest peak in more than a century, driving surprise victories for Democrats.
